Mapping controlling which accounts are exempt from transfer fees.
Total reflections supply, reduced by _reflectFee and read by _getCurrentSupply.
Accumulated token fees, incremented in _reflectFee.
Reflection tax percentage, zeroed by removeAllFee and reset by restoreAllFee.

Blacklist mapping checked in _transfer and set by setBots/delBot.

Payable team address receiving ETH fees in sendETHToFee.
Payable marketing address receiving ETH fees in sendETHToFee.
Trusted Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps, liquidity and approvals.
Created Uniswap V2 pair address used in _transfer gating and approvals.
Flag set by openTrading indicating trading has been enabled.
Re-entrancy style lock flag toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Flag that enables automatic token-to-ETH swaps inside _transfer.
Toggles the per-wallet cooldown enforcement for buys.
Maximum transferable amount enforced in _transfer and set by setMaxTxPercent.
Owner address used by the onlyOwner modifier and renounceOwnership.

Core internal transfer routine: applies bot checks, cooldown, max-tx limit, swap logic and fee handling.

Wraps _transferStandard and temporarily removes/restores fees when takeFee is false.
Performs reflection balance updates and distributes team and reflection fees.
Takes the team portion of a transfer into the contract's reflection balance.
Reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal to reflect the distributed fee.
Computes r/t amounts by combining _getTValues, _getRate and _getRValues.
Computes token fee, team and transfer amounts from _taxFee and _teamFee.
Computes reflection amounts from token amounts and the current rate.
Divides reflection supply by token supply to derive the current rate.
Returns current reflection and token supply with a floor guard.
Owner-only update of _maxTxAmount as a percentage of _tTotal.
Owner-only toggle of the cooldownEnabled flag.
ERC20 transfer entry point delegating to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.

Returns the token balance derived from the account's reflection balance.

Internal allowance writer with zero-address checks.

Restores _taxFee and _teamFee after a fee-exempt transfer.
Owner-only function that renounces ownership by clearing _owner.
View returning the current owner address.
Fallback receive function accepting plain ETH transfers.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, transfers and approvals.

External ETH transfer to _marketingFunds inside sendETHToFee.

edges.reason: manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to _teamAddress.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to _teamAddress.
setBots is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender to _owner.
_transfer uses _msgSender() in the cooldown/unipair caller restriction checks.
_transfer gates buys using block.timestamp for the per-address cooldown.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline to the router call.
block.timestamp is supplied as the deadline for addLiquidityETH.
constructor mint assigns the full reflection supply to _msgSender().
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender into _transfer.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender when reducing the allowance.
approve grants an allowance on behalf of _msgSender().
constructor marks owner, contract and fee wallets as excluded from fees.
_transfer delegates the actual token movement to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not in swap.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee after swapping tokens for ETH.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to perform the transfer math.
_tokenTransfer removes fees when takeFee is false.
_tokenTransfer restores fees after a fee-exempt transfer.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to allocate the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to allocate the reflection fee.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute the r/t amounts.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token amounts.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection amounts.
_getValues calls _getRate for the current rate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply to obtain r/t supply.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve.
swapTokensForEth executes the external router swap call.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH through the router.
openTrading calls the factory to create the Uniswap pair.
openTrading approves the pair for unlimited router allowance.
openTrading assigns the created pair to uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading assigns the router instance to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading enables swapEnabled after providing liquidity.
openTrading sets the tradingOpen flag.
sendETHToFee performs an ETH transfer to _teamAddress.
sendETHToFee performs an ETH transfer to _marketingFunds.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the whole contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee on the contract ETH balance.
setBots writes true flags into the bots mapping.
delBot clears the bot flag for an address.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled toggle.
setMaxTxPercent updates _maxTxAmount from _tTotal.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit on transfers.
_transfer writes cooldown[to] using block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value.
_transfer reads bots[from]/bots[to] to block blacklisted accounts.
_takeTeam adds the team reflection into _rOwned of the contract.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee adds the token fee to _tFeeTotal.
The external router swap call executes while _transfer state updates are in progress, allowing re-entry into transfer logic.
External ETH transfer to _teamAddress inside the _transfer swap sequence can re-enter the token contract.
External addLiquidityETH call can re-enter openTrading before tradingOpen is set.
sendETHToFee reads _teamAddress as the recipient of half the ETH.
sendETHToFee reads _marketingFunds as the recipient of half the ETH.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for approve and swap.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair for swap and cooldown logic.
_getTValues uses _taxFee to compute the reflection tax amount.
_getTValues uses _teamFee to compute the team fee amount.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal as the reflection supply.
_transferStandard debits/credits _rOwned for sender and recipient.
renounceOwnership is restricted to the current _owner.
setMaxTxPercent is restricted to _owner via onlyOwner.
openTrading is restricted to _owner via onlyOwner.
setCooldownEnabled is restricted to _owner via onlyOwner.
_approve writes the allowance into the _allowances mapping.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether to take fees.
The lockTheSwap modifier on swapTokensForEth toggles the inSwap guard.
_getRate indirectly reads _rTotal through _getCurrentSupply.
balanceOf reads _rOwned[account] and converts it to tokens.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter from is only consumed by _transfer and should be folded into it.
Parameter to is only consumed by _transfer and should be folded into it.
Parameter amount is only consumed by _transfer and should be folded into it.
Parameter tokenAmount is only used by swapTokensForEth.
Local path array is constructed only inside swapTokensForEth.
Parameter amount_fee is only used by sendETHToFee.
Parameter bots_ is only iterated inside setBots.
Parameter notbot is only used by delBot.
Parameter maxTxPercent is only used by setMaxTxPercent.
Parameter onoff is only used by setCooldownEnabled.
Constructor parameter addr1 is only assigned to _teamAddress.
Constructor parameter addr2 is only assigned to _marketingFunds.
Local msgSender is a temporary alias of _msgSender() in the constructor.
Local currentRate is only used inside tokenFromReflection.
Parameter account is only used by balanceOf.
